correctness.rationale: All new faces are exactly within three triangular neighborhoods A_i and three cone neighborhoods B_i. Unique two-leaf-vertex edges give three genuine triangle-edge collapses; the remaining new faces are precisely disjoint-by-new-vertex cones x_i*L_i on old simplices. Ordered descending pivot pairings remove every cone face, and each lower face then has exactly its proposed upper coface. There are 3+3*2^(d+1) elementary pairs, yielding exactly the old neighborhood complex. This proves all quantifiers and the exact count. Standalone independent face construction tested 320 varied graph leaves and 22,080 individual free-face pairs; the finite checks are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A motivated structural graph operation changes the product graph dramatically but provably leaves its open neighborhood complex unchanged up to explicit simple-homotopy collapse when the clique fiber has width three. The theorem is all-graph, including arbitrarily high degree; it removes all pendant trees from computations, completely classifies all tree bases as circles, preserves torus cup products in unicyclic cores, and has a sharp boundary because width four does not share the invariance. This is not a parameter renaming or a finite-table calculation.
